verses.text: Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Ab'i, ha t'a skal yinhtilal winhaj Judá ix in sik'kanel winhaj Bezaleel, yuninal winhaj Uri, yixchikin winhaj Hur.
Toxo ix wak'och Wespíritu t'a winh, yik jelan snaanel winh, yik ol yal sb'oank'e yalnhej tastak winh.
Ol snaanelta winh sb'oan yechel jantak munlajel ol b'o'ok, icha t'a k'een oro, t'a k'een plata yet' t'a k'een bronke,
yet' pax sb'oan k'een k'een winh wach' yilji, sb'oan te te' t'a yalnhej tas munlajelal.

Haxo winhaj Aholiab, yuninal winhaj Ahisamac, yinhtilal winhaj Dan, a winh ol kolwaj yet' winhaj Bezaleel chi'. Masanil heb' aytaxon sjelanil, ix in wach' ak'ej sjelanil heb' yik a heb' ol b'oan masanil tastak swal tik t'ayach:
Haton k'apak mantiado b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a, te' skaxail in trato yet' smakul b'aj tz'ak'ji tup mul, masanil syamk'ab'il t'a yol mantiado chi',
te' mexa yet' jantak syamk'ab'il, jun sb'akhnub' kandil nab'a oro yet' syamk'ab'il, jun altar b'aj snhuschaj inkienso,
jun altar b'aj stz'a silab' yet' syamk'ab'il, jun niwan palangana yet' sb'akhnub' yich,
k'apak pichul jalb'il niwan yelk'ochi, haton spichul winhaj sakerdote Aarón yet' pax spichul heb' yuninal winh, haton pichul sk'an heb' t'a yopisio.

Sb'opax akeite heb' sk'anchaji ayik tz'ochkan junok mach, ma junok tas wikok. Sb'opax inkienso manhxo jantakok swach'il sk'anchaj t'a in kajnub'. Ha juntzanh chi', yowalil sb'o heb' icha wal ix aj walan t'ayach, xchi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi':

Al t'a heb' etchonhab' to yowalil sk'anab'ajej jun sk'ual ik'oj ip heb', yujto wik yaji. Yujto a jun k'u chi' yechel in trato yajkanoch t'a ko kal heyet'ok t'a masanil tiempo yik wach' tzeyojtakejeli to a in Jehová in tik ix ex in sik'kanel wikok.
Niwanokab' yelk'och jun sk'ual ik'oj ip chi' t'a yol he sat. Ha mach max k'anab'ajan jun k'ual ik'oj ip chi', yowalil schami. Yalnhej mach smunlaj t'a jun k'u chi', yowalil schami.
Wakenhej k'ual tzex munlaji, haxo t'a yukil k'ual, sk'ual ik'oj ip, wiknhej yaji. Yalnhej mach smunlaj t'a jun k'u chi', tojolnhej schami.

Yuj chi', yowalil tze k'anab'ajej jun k'ual ik'oj ip chi'. Ha jun chi' yechel in trato tz'ajkan t'a masanil tiempo t'a ko kal heyet'ok, yujto a in Jehová in t'a wake' k'ual in b'onak satcha'anh yet' sat lu'um tik, haxo t'a yukil k'ual wochnak waan in munlaji, wik'annak wip, xchi Jehová.
Ayik ix lajwi slolon Jehová yet' winhaj Moisés t'a jolom witz Sinaí, ix yak'an chab' pachanh k'een t'a winh, b'aj tz'ib'ab'iloch strato, to a wal Dios ix tz'ib'ani.
